kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 330 (RHP / NSE). At Rs 330: market cap Rs 3,232.6 cr post-issue; P/E 20.9x FY26 EPS on post-issue shares (20.0x pre-issue); P/B 3.5x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 13.5x FY26.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow Rs -11.69 / +65.51 / -25.80 cr FY24-26 against owners' PAT Rs 141.61 / 144.06 / 154.36 cr: cumulative CFO 6% of PAT. Trade receivables rose by Rs 173.64 cr in FY26; cash conversion cycle 156 -> 232 -> 242 days (411 days at Jun-26, seasonal). Q1 FY27 CFO -Rs 21.34 cr. The working-capital object (Rs 74.92 cr) is sized for this.

focus.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
focus.detail: Goodwill up from Rs 2.81 cr to Rs 30.32 cr after buying 80% of IST-Anlagenbau GmbH (Germany, solar sludge dryers) on 30-Jul-2025 for Rs 32.32 cr, against Rs 4.81 cr of net assets acquired; no impairment so far.

focus.title: Contingent liabilities
focus.detail: Ten show-cause notices (Jul-2025 to Sep-2026) from the Goa SPCB and GWMC to subsidiaries HWTPL and VWTPL over effluent and waste-handling at the North and South Goa plants, plus the Aug-2025 FIR; responses filed, all pending. Portugal claim EUR 5.60 m (Rs 59.75 cr, 7.4% of net worth) against SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH pending; two ex-MDs of that subsidiary claim about EUR 0.2-0.3 m in Austria.

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: G B C A & Associates LLP; no qualifications. Overseas subsidiaries' accounts partly certified by management (FY24-25 per DRHP); confirm audit status in the RHP auditor's report.
